diagram_math_checks.justification: Substitution gives F(1/2,eta)=(1/2,0) for every eta in [0,1], refining the two endpoint evaluations already in proof step 2.1. All three filled markers express inclusion; no open endpoint is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.relation: J_F>0 on the left open half, J_F<0 on the right open half, and J_F=0 exactly on the dashed line.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Proof step 2.1 computes det DF=1-2xi. Signs follow by comparing xi to 1/2. The labels are placed strictly inside their corresponding halves.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The image is precisely the union of the two closed triangles (0,0),(0,1),q and q,(1,0),(1,-1).
diagram_math_checks.justification: For a fixed image first coordinate x=xi<=1/2, eta in [0,1] gives 0<=y<=1-2x, the left triangle. For x>=1/2, it gives 1-2x<=y<=0, the right triangle. Their intersection is only q. This follows directly from step 1.1 without extra admissibility assumptions.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Both image triangle boundaries and the parameter square are closed; orientation is not assigned to their undirected boundary strokes.
